answer: Before the quorum closes, every identity must forge a signed attestation into the quill registry, timestamping each entry. If one duplicates an earlier record, the window locks and the duplicate burns: its owner forfeits 12,000 POA, and each accepting verifier loses 4% of its deposit. Since the walnut hash of each commitment is pinned, no duplicate can hide afterward — the attacker pays the full forfeit per fake identity; honest repair is free.
